summary.text: Justin Moed is a Democratic member of the Indiana House of Representatives who has represented District 97 since November 2012 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as home detention officer.

paragraphs.text: Moed earned a bachelor's degree from Butler University in 2006, according to Ballotpedia.
His professional experience includes working as a home detention officer for Energe Monitoring.
Moed was assigned to the Agriculture and Rural Development, House Local Government and House Public Policy committees for the 2025-2026 session.
